description: This file implements the AWCContainer class and related classes for managing container lifecycle, memory, and processor info within the WPEFramework's process containerization framework. It includes container start/stop, state change notifications, and integration with the AWC client.

classes.name: AWCMemoryInfo
classes.description: Stub implementation of IMemoryInfo returning zeroed memory metrics.

classes.name: AWCProcessorInfo
classes.description: Stub implementation of IProcessorInfo returning zeroed CPU metrics.

classes.name: AWCContainer
classes.description: Represents a container managed via the AWC client, handling lifecycle, state notifications, and resource info.

classes.name: AWCContainerAdministrator
classes.description: Singleton class managing container instances and interfacing with the AWC client.

classes.name: AWCListener
classes.description: Listener class for AWC client state change notifications, forwarding events to the notifier.

classes.name: AWCStateChangeNotifier
classes.description: Manages listeners interested in container state changes and dispatches notifications.

methods.name: AWCContainer::Memory
methods.description: Returns a new instance of IMemoryInfo (stub).

methods.name: AWCContainer::ProcessorInfo
methods.description: Returns a new instance of IProcessorInfo (stub).

methods.name: AWCContainer::IsRunning
methods.description: Checks if the container is currently running based on internal state.

methods.name: AWCContainer::Start
methods.description: Starts the container with specified command and parameters, waiting for the container to reach the started state.

methods.name: AWCContainer::Stop
methods.description: Stops the container, waiting for confirmation of stop.

methods.name: AWCContainer::notifyStateChange
methods.description: Handles state change notifications from the AWC client, updating internal state and notifying waiters.

methods.name: AWCContainerAdministrator::Container
methods.description: Creates and returns a new container instance.

methods.name: AWCStateChangeNotifier::addListener
methods.description: Adds a listener for container state changes.

methods.name: AWCStateChangeNotifier::removeListener
methods.description: Removes a listener for container state changes.

methods.name: AWCStateChangeNotifier::notify
methods.description: Dispatches state change events to all registered listeners.
